messages:
Maya: Heads up — VendorX pushed a revised ETA for the 4 racks we reserved. New ETA moved from 2025-06-29 to 2025-07-12. This bumps our marketplace staging window and the SI pilot.
Alex: Ugh, timeline slip noted. Do we know if this affects the SKU staging manifest or just freight routing?
Maya: Bob says it's a factory scheduling shuffle, not customs. They reallocated a production slot. He sent updated manifest yesterday.
Bob-VendorX: (Vendor) Confirming — production bump, earliest ship date now 2025-07-10, port ETD 2025-07-12. Can prioritize one rack earlier for pickup if needed.
Sam: If we get 1 rack earlier, can partner SI start the onboarding sandbox? We need at least 1 node to begin integration tests with the SI.
Keiko: For marketplace staging we planned a 3-day soak after racks arrive in our AWS staging DC. If first rack arrives earlier, we can start partial staging but listing requires full QA across all racks.
Alex: What are options: (A) accept later full launch, (B) partial staging with soft announcement to SI only, (C) push rush fee to vendor for split shipment. Cost impact?
Maya: EMs prefer (B) for product velocity. Sales + SI want to avoid a public launch that could create support tickets.
Sam: Agree — let's keep public marketplace listing blocked until full QA, but start SI pilot on the single rack. That gives us demo parity for partners.
Keiko: Logistics note: split shipments add customs risk and increase handling. If we split, we need updated PO + updated freight terms. Estimate extra 8-12% per rack.
Maya: Can Bob confirm if single-rack early release is net-new or will reassign one of the four?
Bob-VendorX: I can confirm we can prioritize one rack separately without changing the rest of the order. Will update the PO and send a new manifest by EOD.
manifest-bot: PO 988271 status changed to PARTIAL_SHIP_APPROVED by Bob-VendorX at 2025-06-20T14:45:02Z
Alex: Okay — action items: 1) Bob to send revised manifest and pricing for split ship (ETA EOD). 2) Keiko to run quick cost delta and customs note. 3) Sam to rescope SI pilot to single-rack asap. 4) Maya to coordinate comms with partner marketing (no public listing until full QA).
Sam: Working on the pilot plan. I need the rack specs and initial IP subnet for the staging DC. @Keiko can you confirm rack arrival booking window so I can book onsite engineer?
Keiko: Tentative pickup slot for prioritized rack: 2025-07-11 to 2025-07-13. Onsite engineer booking request looks doable. I'll confirm carrier ETA once manifest arrives.
Maya: Marketing: let's tentatively hold the joint announcement until we have final full-availability date. Will craft a partner-only update if SI needs to demo earlier.
Alex: If vendor charges for split, we need budget approval. @Maya can you flag Finance? This might come out of partnership co-op.
Maya: Yep, I'll ping Finance and ask for a $10k buffer for rush/split fees.
Bob-VendorX: Manifest uploaded:
```
SKU: RACK-XL-8GPU
Qty: 1
Serials: RX-1001,RX-1002,...
ETA Factory: 2025-07-08
ETD Port: 2025-07-12
```
Maya: Thanks. If manifest holds, Sam, can you target a pilot kickoff for week of 2025-07-21? That gives Keiko time to land + stage.
Sam: Yes, week of 7/21 works if we get the rack earlier. I'll draft the pilot checklist and tag the SI.
Keiko: One more: customs brokerage needs invoice copy and HS codes. Bob, please include HS code list in the manifest update.
Bob-VendorX: Will include HS codes in the revised manifest.
Maya: Alright — I'll summarize in a one-pager and post back here once Finance responds. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread so we have a single source of truth.
Sam: Adding a note — if anything else slips, we should consider toggling marketplace listing to "coming soon" with no provisioning enabled, so customers aren't charged or provisioned prematurely.
Maya: Good idea. I'll coordinate with Platform on listing gating.
manifest-bot: Reminder: PO 988271 updated manifests available at https://vendorx.manifests/988271 (access restricted)
Keiko: FYI carrier ETA will be final after customs doc OK. I'll flag if anything else changes.
Bob-VendorX: Thanks team — I'll send the firm manifest + split pricing by EOD PST.
Maya: Appreciated. End of thread for now.
